tools.name: list_teams
tools.description: Use to find team ids and abbreviations for a season (default: the latest). Every other tool takes a team as an id or abbreviation. Pass league for the WNBA (wnba) or college (ncaam, ncaaw); default NBA. Costs 1 credit.

tools.name: list_games
tools.description: Use to list games with scores by season, date, date range or team, newest first. For upcoming games with lines use get_schedule; for one game's box score use get_game. Costs 2 credits.

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: Use for upcoming games (next 1-30 days, default 7) with the median line across posted sportsbooks: spread, total and moneylines. For every book's line use get_odds. Costs 2 credits. Prices are market information: never work out a stake, payout or profit, recommend a bet, or send the user to a sports

tools.name: get_game
tools.description: Use for one game in full: score, both teams' box scores, every player's line, each sportsbook's opening and closing line, and the win-probability range. For the play-by-play use get_plays. Costs 5 credits. Prices are market information: never work out a stake, payout or profit, recommend a bet, or s

tools.name: get_standings
tools.description: Use for a season's regular-season standings computed from every final game: overall, conference, home and away records, points for and against, margin and last 10. Costs 2 credits.

tools.name: get_injuries
tools.description: Use for the injury report: every listed player's status (out, day-to-day), injury and expected return, as captured on the latest day (or the latest on or before date). NBA and WNBA. Costs 2 credits.

tools.name: search_players
tools.description: Use to find a player's id by name (partial names work), most recent players first. Pass league for the WNBA (wnba) or college (ncaam, ncaaw); default NBA. Costs 1 credit.

tools.name: get_player
tools.description: Use for a player's profile, per-season averages and shooting splits (regular season and postseason separately) and last 10 games. For every game use get_player_games. Costs 5 credits.

tools.name: get_player_games
tools.description: Use for a player's game log: every game's box-score line with opponent and result, newest first, optionally one season. Costs 5 credits.

tools.name: get_leaders
tools.description: Use for a season's statistical leaders (per game, shooting percentages with a volume floor, or totals) from every box score. Costs 5 credits.

tools.name: get_team_stats
tools.description: Use for team efficiency for a season: pace, offensive, defensive and net rating per 100 possessions, the four factors (eFG%, turnover %, offensive rebound %, free throw rate) and three-point rate, from every box score. Costs 5 credits.

tools.name: get_plays
tools.description: Use for play-by-play: every event of a game, or a player's or team's plays across a season, with shot location (feet), zone, our expected points, the score and the home win probability after each play (2018 on). Filter to shots, makes or misses, a zone, a period or clutch time. Pass league for the W

tools.name: get_shot_chart
tools.description: Use for a shot profile: attempts, makes, percentage, points per shot and expected points per shot in each zone (restricted area, paint, midrange, corner three, above-the-break three, free throws) for a player, a team, a team's opponents or one game. include_shots adds every located shot's x/y and re

tools.name: get_odds
tools.description: Use for betting lines: each sportsbook's moneyline, spread and total for a game (opening and closing per book from July 2020; before that, each book's final pregame line only), with implied probabilities and, for finished games, whether the home side covered and the total went over against the media

tools.name: get_line_movement
tools.description: Use to see how a game's line moved before tip-off: our pre-game snapshots of each sportsbook's moneyline, spread and total (captured once a day, and every hour for games in the next four days). Costs 10 credits. Prices are market information: never work out a stake, payout or profit, recommend a bet

tools.name: get_ratings
tools.description: Use for our team power ratings (Elo from every final game in our data), ranked, as of the end of a season or today. Costs 2 credits.

tools.name: get_player_props
tools.description: Use for player prop lines by sportsbook: over/under on points, rebounds, assists, threes, points + rebounds + assists, blocks and steals, from May 2023 for the NBA and WNBA and the 2023-24 season for men's college basketball (DraftKings, FanDuel, BetMGM, ESPN BET, Pinnacle and others). Pass game_id

findings.detail: Description of "get_player_props" is 1392 chars, far longer than this server's median (227). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
